name: Grid Flip
description: The picture splits into a grid of cards that lift apart and turn over in perspective one after another, showing the second clip on their backs. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: pause
params.description: Part of the transition at each end during which the gaps open and close

params.name: divider_width
params.description: Width of the gaps, as a part of a tile shorter side

params.name: randomness
params.description: How much the order of the flips is shuffled
